name: Hybrid Rocket Propulsion
summary: Rockets that combine a solid fuel grain with a liquid or gaseous oxidiser: their physics, performance and design trades.

topics.name: Oxidiser mass flux and regression rate laws
Mixture-ratio shift and grain port design
Oxidiser feed: self-pressurised nitrous oxide and LOX
Combustion efficiency and instabilities in hybrids
Hybrid applications: SpaceShipOne/Two, sounding rockets and student rockets
